facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that on 14 November 2025 Niger's communications minister provisionally received 1,031 km of fibre laid across the territory under the trans-Saharan fibre backbone project (EUR 43 million, AfDB group and Niger), begun in 2021; the fibre is to carry traffic once put in service.

NER.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin, citing the ITU, says 2 GB of mobile broadband in Niger still costs about 8.5% of average monthly income per person (2 GB, not 5 GB; 2024 ITU basis stated for the African figures).

NER.note: A future national data centre is mentioned only as a planned link target; none in service stated.
Fibre reaches five borders and interconnection is only possible; no agreement with a named partner body is stated.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payments.
